Compose the cCoder platform domains into one operational application, with a guided bootstrap path for a new environment.

Why Core exists

cCoder.Core is the supported composition boundary for the wider platform. It brings security, content, documents, workflow, mail, logging, packaging and application security into usable web and background hosts without hiding which domain owns each capability.

What operators gain

  • One composition layer for the platform-facing web application and hosted services.
  • Startup database migration for the configured Core and SSO stores.
  • A first-time setup flow that creates the initial tenant, administrator and application.
  • Repeatable baseline imports sourced from the versioned cCoder.Assets repository.

Start with a new environment

Use the First Time Setup guide when Core is connected to new databases and presents the one-time administrator form.

Keep domain ownership visible

Core coordinates the domains; it does not absorb them. Domain APIs, persistence models and packages remain independently owned so applications can compose the platform without turning the aggregate into a second implementation of every capability.
